title: Swing Revival
style: funk, Hyperactive jazz-pop meets Brazilian funk groove with mento bounce and a crooked dark-cabaret piano. Bright brass stabs, rubbery bass, and clattering percussion keep everything rushing forward; verses stay frantic and playful, chorus hooks explode with gang vocals and call‐and‐response. Male vocals, sly and theatrical, with stacked harmonies on the hook and a brief half‐time breakdown before the final chorus., jazz, dark cabaret, pop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Pixel parade on a tightrope night
Glitches in gold
Sequins so bright
Masks made of code
Teeth made of chrome
Dancing on tables that call themselves home

[Pre-Chorus]
Confetti of colors in my hard drive
You spin like a record
I short-circuit alive
Screens flicker fever
They’re keeping the score
We laugh
We crash
We beg for more

[Chorus]
Digital echo masquerade
Spin me around till the data fades
Laugh in the lag
Let the ghosts upgrade
Hey
Hey
Hey
It’s a brand new glitch parade
Digital echo masquerade
Feet on fire while the world upgrades
Clap to the crack in the big charade
Hey
Hey
Hey
Digital echo masquerade

[Verse 2]
Rum in the rhythm of a busted fan
Horn section howling like it lost its plan
Jesters in jackets made of scrolling text
Shuffle the deck
Then they dance with the next

[Pre-Chorus]
Heartbeat hammer in a syncopated room
Smoke ring halos over neon bloom
You steal my worries with a sideways grin
"Press any key" so the chaos begins

[Chorus]

[Bridge]
[whispered vocals] Left
Right
Left
Right
Wrong turn
Still right tonight
[cabaret piano vamp]
Raise your glass to the bugs in the code
To the saints in sequins on this overload
[call-and-response] I say “crash” — you say “play”
We turn the error into cabaret

[Chorus]
